beats.care: Buses leave Bagkhal at 8:30 and 9 am, and Karunamoyee at 5:30 and 6 pm. Fares follow WBTC's chart.
beats.what: AC-59 runs Bagkhal–Karunamoyee via Uttarpara, Dakshineswar, the Airport, Chinar Park and New Town, under a WBTC order.
beats.why: It gives the Uttarpara–Dakshineswar side a direct AC ride to the New Town and Salt Lake office belt.

cards.body: Just two trips each way per day for now.
cards.caption: Bagkhal to Karunamoyee

cards.body: WBTC is running it in one-shift mode from its Salt Lake and Belgharia depots. Reports differ on the start date, but it runs until further notice.

cards.q: Would you take AC-59 to work?

opts: Office-goers heading to Salt Lake–New Town
cards.q: Who is AC-59's timetable mainly built for?
cards.why: Morning trips go towards Salt Lake and evening trips come back, matching office hours.

hook: One AC bus from *Uttarpara to Salt Lake*, via the airport

learn.t: AC-59 runs towards Salt Lake only in the morning and back only in the evening, timed for office-goers.

sources.name: Millennium Post
sources.title: WBTC to launch new AC bus service

sources.name: India Hood Bangla
sources.title: যাত্রী সুবিধার্থে কলকাতায় নতুন এসি বাস রুট চালু করল WBTC, জানুন খুঁটিনাটি

tldr: WBTC has launched AC-59, a 37 km AC bus from Bagkhal near Uttarpara to Karunamoyee in Salt Lake via the airport and New Town.
